title: Murwere
intro: Kare kare, mumazuva ekutanga enhoroondo yevanhu, mweya miviri yakamira pamberi peMusiki wayo nezvipiriso. Mumwe akagamuchirwa, mumwe haana kugamuchirwa. Zvakazotevera zvaizova dambudziko guru rekutanga pakati pehama - chiito chimwe chekushivirira uye chiito chimwe chekutsiva zvinorwadza. Unogona kuziva kuti ndini ani?
clues: Ndakazvarwa mumazuva ekutanga ehupenyu hwemunhu panyika
Ndaiva mwana wevanhu vaviri vekutanga kufamba panyika
Ndakambopa chibayiro kubva kuboka rangu rakanakisisa kuti ndifadze Musiki wangu
Chipo changu chakagamuchirwa kubva kumusoro, asi chechipo chemukoma wangu chakarambwa
Pandakatyisidzirwa nerufu, ndakasarudza kusasimudza ruoko rwangu ndichirwisa munin'ina wangu
Ndakava munhu wekutanga munhoroondo yevanhu kuurayiwa zvisiri pamutemo nemumwe munhu

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
